title: Tollway operators all set for heavier traffic for ‘Undas’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The country’s two largest tollway operators are bracing for heavier traffic across major expressways during “Undas,” when millions of Filipinos are expected to travel to their hometowns to visit departed loved ones. Ramon Ang-led SMC Infrastructure said it expects vehicle traffic across its tollway network to increase by 10 percent, while Manuel Pangilinan-led Metro Pacific Tollways Corp. (MPTC) projects a 5-percent rise overall. During the peak travel days of Oct. 30 and Oct. 31, MPTC expects traffic across its expressways to surge by an average of 12 percent.
